description: Yukon Delta Villages Document Baseline Environmental Data is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Yukon River Inter-Tribal Watershed Council; USGS Alaska Science Center; EPA Indian Environmental General Assistance Program. Students and community residents of four remote Alaskan villages measure environmental data to identify their climate vulnerabilities. Coverage: the United States (2015). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
